ownerThemes.theme: PatternReview members comparing the 4423, 4432 and 4452 describe them as the same machine with different stitch counts and accessory packs, and suggest buying on price.
Review roundups say the 4452's walking foot and nonstick foot are the reason to pick it over the 4432, and that the head itself is identical.
Retailer review pages for the 4452 repeat the 44-series pattern: strong on denim hems, with tension and bobbin complaints from a minority of owners.

crossShop.why: Identical head without the walking foot, nonstick foot and clearance plate.
Brother's competitor ships a nonstick foot too, with 37 stitches at a lower speed.
Buyers who outgrow the Singer on quilts or bags step up to a single-stitch Juki.

editorial.verdict: The 4432 head plus the two feet most heavy fabric beginners end up buying anyway, at a modest premium.
editorial.whoFor: Beginners planning to sew denim, vinyl or layered totes who want the walking foot and nonstick foot in the box.
editorial.skipIf: You already own a walking foot, or you need real industrial capacity for leather and webbing.
editorial.keySpec: 1,100 spm · 32 stitches · walking + nonstick foot · 1-step buttonhole
strengths: Singer publishes the same 1,100 spm and metal frame as the rest of the line.
Even feed foot, nonstick foot and clearance plate are on Singer's own accessory list.
Two packs of needles and Class 15 bobbins are included.
weaknesses: Machine weight is not published in accessible sources.
Head is identical to the 4432; the premium buys accessories, not capability.
Shares the 44-series bobbin and tension complaints.

checks.title: Factory serviced units
checks.body: SMP lists a factory serviced 4452 near $160 against $299 new. Ask for the warranty term on refurbished stock before choosing.

checks.title: Verify the foot list
checks.body: Some comparison sites list a satin stitch foot as the 4452 extra. Singer's sheet lists even feed and nonstick feet plus a clearance plate. Check the box contents on the listing.

checks.title: Free arm and storage
checks.body: The accessory tray doubles as the free arm cover on this line. Confirm the listing includes it if buying open box.

realCost: Denim needles size 16 to 18 beyond the included packs
Leather or vinyl needles if using the nonstick foot on those materials
